descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S16 The computer deletes a patient whose chart is open, mid-typing, on the phone

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time. (UAT TC-25 step 5; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 18; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Phone on {hospitalPatient}'s Pre-Round tab with typed, autosaved text

When The computer removes {hospitalPatient} from the Hospital list (confirm once)

Then Without a refresh, the phone stops showing that patient's name and text, tells the physician something with a way back to the list (not a blank screen), and the list no longer has the patient. The Nursing Home resident is untouched

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 (phone, no reload) mustContain 'Patient not found' and 'Back to rounds' (a message that the patient is gone and a control back to the list; this is main's wording, routes/rounding/Patient.tsx:71-77, and a person confirms once that it reads as the UAT intends) and mustNotContain {hospitalPatient}, 'QA-SYNC-PR-D', 'Sign-in code' and 'Something went wrong' (so a p …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
